query: Set up linting for our Ansible repo.
expected_behavior: Uses ansible-lint with profile production plus yamllint
Runs the same checks in pre-commit and CI
Does not add rules to skip_list to silence findings without a written reason

query: How do I test the chrony role?
expected_behavior: Creates a molecule scenario with converge and verify playbooks
Runs converge twice or uses the idempotence step and expects zero changes
Tests on every supported distribution with one platform each
Explains tasks that depend on a previous changed step or run command without check_mode handling fail in check mode
Fixes with check_mode, when guards or ansible_check_mode instead of disabling check runs

query: Apply the change to production now.
expected_behavior: Does not treat this as a testing task
Defers to the deploy workflow and asks for confirmation
